Package neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi

Class Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageWriter

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.processmodel.dexpi.Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageWriter
public final class Dexpi20ProcessModelPackageWriter extends Object
Writes a deterministic multi-area NeqSim package containing native DEXPI 2.0 Process exchanges.

DEXPI Process files remain independently schema/profile assessed, one per ProcessSystem area. A NeqSim manifest preserves the plant-wide canonical graph fingerprint, stable area identities and cross-area connection identities. The package is not a new DEXPI profile and does not claim that manifest-only connections are present in a native whole-plant DEXPI model.
